metrics.first_candidate_precision_bounds_interpr: All-first-candidate usefulness identification bounds, not confidence intervals. Unresolved first candidates can be useful or non-useful; known post-arrival first candidates are non-useful. Conditional precision instead conditions on mature eligible first targets.
metrics.scored_trip_definition: At least one mature eligible label, irrespective forecast availability.
metrics.trip_weighting: Each tenant/trip contributes at most one recall hit; all admitted candidates count toward burden.
